name: Market Intelligence API
description: Pay-per-call market intelligence for AI agents, built on observed data. On-chain order flow from executed DEX trades on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Robinhood Chain and Solana (buy/sell pressure, momentum, anomalies vs each asset's own baseline, large trades, smart-money wallets, candles and daily datasets); token risk checks and swap quotes; Hyperliquid perps funding, open interest and crowding; SEC EDGAR (XBRL fundamentals, Form 4, Form 144, 13D/13G, dividends, fails-to-deliver, 8-K) and European ESEF fundamentals; European short interest (AMF); ECB, Eurostat, US Treasury and Federal Reserve data; CFTC positioning, EIA oil inventories and the official macro calendar; GDELT and SEC news; and deterministic analytics primitives on numbers you supply. Every answer is timestamped and names its source. Decisions (/api/v1/decision*) are a rule-based aggregation of these data with a free, live track record (/api/v1/decision/track-record). The chain query parameter of the token routes names the chain the token lives on; it is never the payment network, which every paid route lists in x-payment-info.networks as CAIP-2 ids.
